newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIRS holds 96/97 French beet sugar crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: FIRS holds 96/97 French beet sugar crop estimate.

text.p: French sugar intervention board FIRS is maintaining its estimate for the 1996/97 beet sugar crop at 3.9 million tonnes against 4.2 million in 1995/96 following the results of the third beet test by sugar manufacturers.

"The results confirmed our expectations of lower yields in 1996. We are holding our forecast of a sugar yield of 9.4 tonnes per hectare and of sugar output of 3.966 tonnes, assuming area of 422,000 hectares," a FIRS official told Reuters on Friday.

The sugar manufacturers' association SNFS said earlier the test carried out on August 26 showed sugar weight per hectare fell by 9.6 percent to 7.647 tonnes from 8.457 tonnes in last year's third test.
